text:
ana: Heads-up from launch morning: site traffic +420% but demo starts only +3%. Can we reconcile before Fridays KPI sync?
sam: Noted. Do we know if traffic is high-quality or just press/social?
leo: Quick peek shows registration rate for the webinar is fine, but demo funnel is cold. Suspiciously high 'other' in source.
marta: We used the short link batch for promos. I remember toggling a redirect setting for the campaign. Might be dropping query params.
leo: Ran a tiny query to check utm presence:
```
select count(*) filter (where utm_source is null) as no_utm, count(*) as total
from sessions
where occurred_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
```
result: no_utm = 6,300 / total = 21,000 (~30%).
sam: 30% unattributed is huge. That explains the mismatch on the dashboard attribution tiles.
ana: ops-bot: shortener service deployment at 09:14 UTC — config preserve_qs=false by default.
ops-bot: server/shortener v1.7.4 deployed (sha: d3f4e), tests green.
marta: Ack. That was my change to reduce cache variance. I can flip preserve_qs to true and redeploy.
sam: Please do asap. Also, leo, can you try to backfill attribution using the click logs and referer matching? We need an adjusted KPI snapshot for leadership.
leo: I'll map click_id -> session_id via the linker logs. Might recover ~65-75% of missing UTMs. Kicking off job now. Job id: backfill-30789-01. ETA ~5h.
nana: For transparency can we add a widget to the KPI dashboard: "unattributed sessions %" and show yesterday vs baseline? CEO asked for that tile specifically.
leo: Sure. I'll add derived metric: unattributed_rate = sum(case when utm_source is null then 1 else 0 end) / sum(1). Will surface in the weekly KPI and set an alert at 20%.
sam: If backfill brings conversions up, we'll annotate the weekly deck and avoid escalation. If it doesn't, we do CTA copy + nurture cadence A/B.
marta: Hotfix PR opened: https://git.company/shortener/pull/419. Includes preserve_qs=true and tests.
ops-bot: PR merged and rolled to canary. No errors so far.
leo: Backfill progress: 30% complete, matched 1,900 click->session records. Posting interim CSV to /reports/launch_backfill/partial_3078901234.csv
sam: Good — please snapshot current KPI dashboard now (pre-backfill) and upload to #marketing for the Friday review. We need before/after visuals.
nana: Snapshot uploaded: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3078901234_pre.png
sam: Thanks. Keep updates here. Once backfill finishes, re-run the dashboards and post the post-backfill snapshot plus a short note on recovered attribution and conversion delta.
nana: Also adding a short blurb to the launch post: "Note: initial analytics undercounted attributed demos due to tracking redirect config; numbers updated in KPI report after 11:00 UTC."
leo: Backfill complete: matched 4,300 of 6,300 unattributed sessions (~68%). Adjusted demo conversion +2.6pp. New snapshot: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3078901234_post.png
sam: Nice recovery. Still a small gap but acceptable. We'll include a one-slide explanation in Friday's weekly KPI.
marta: Added checklist item: "verify preserve_qs for all campaign short links" to launch playbook.
nana: Closing loop: set alert for unattributed_rate > 20% and add runbook steps to escalate to eng if >35%.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: marketing.unattributed_rate > 0.20 (notify #marketing, #eng-oncall).
sam: Closing — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in the KPI huddle if numbers deviate after the next push. :raised_hands:
